|
# **Is Mississippi Really as Poor as Britain?**
---
| The question is usually posed the other way around—which is an insult to the dynamic economy of this southern state that is now my home. By Douglas Carswell
---
| The shame of it! Mississippi has found itself in the humiliating position of being compared disobligingly with the United Kingdom. Just last week, the _Financial Times _ran a column asking, “Is Britain Really as Poor as Mississippi?”

Most Mississippians do not spend much time worrying about comparisons with Britain. The same cannot be said about those on the other side of the Atlantic. For Brits—and I am one, though now based in Jackson, Mississippi—the issue of whether they are more or less prosperous than Mississippi has become a thing. Indeed, the _Financial Times_ now calls it “the Mississippi Question.”

It was nine years ago when Fraser Nelson, the editor of _The Spectator_ , first suggested that the U.K. was poorer than any U.S. state but Mississippi. This came as an uncomfortable shock for many in Britain for whom _Mississippi_ , as a byword for backwardness _, _conjures up clichés about the Deep South. Every time anyone has made the comparison since, there has been an indignant outburst from Britons keen to denounce the data.

In practice, when trying to provide a definitive answer to the Mississippi Question, no uniform, up-to-date set of data exists. But if you take the most recent U.S. figure for Mississippi’s GDP and divide it by the state’s population, you get a pretty accurate figure for GDP per capita in current dollar values. Make the same calculation for the U.K., with total GDP data divided by the population, and you end up with two comparable numbers.

Last year, by my math, the U.K.’s output per person was the equivalent of $45,485; Mississippi’s was higher, at $47,190. If Britain were invited to join the U.S. as the 51st state, its citizens would be at the bottom of the table for per capita GDP. Some might say that, for Mississippi, that is still disconcertingly close.

“That’s not fair!” the critics would counter. “When you compare the wealth of nations, you need to look at how far the money goes. Things cost more in the U.K. than in Mississippi.” To adjust the raw numbers, the argument runs, you need to use an economist’s tool called “purchasing power parity.” Sure enough, when you consider differences in the price of things in Britain and in America, the U.K. does appear richer than Mississippi. Thus, after such PPP adjustments, a _Financial Times_ analyst suggested that for 2021, Mississippi’s per capita GDP was a mere $46,841 to the U.K.’s $54,590 (though conceding that, without the global city-state effect of London’s economy, much of Britain was relatively poorer than the Magnolia State).

“Hold on!” we on Team Mississippi retort. “Why adjust the numbers for our state using U.S. national data?” Here, a dollar goes a lot further than it would in New England or on the West Coast. To produce PPP-adjusted numbers for Mississippi that reflect the buying power of a dollar in places like New York or San Francisco, we say, is absurd. And sure enough, tinkering with the numbers to reflect purchasing power in Mississippi itself puts doubt on the U.K. coming out ahead.

Perhaps more interesting, however, than the way you cut the numbers for any given year is the fact that the gap between Mississippi and Britain seems to be growing. Never mind PPP—just run the numbers for GDP per capita in current dollars for the first part of 2023, rather than 2022, and you can see that Mississippi’s output is rising at a faster rate than Britain’s.

Over the past 30 years, several southern U.S. states have seen rapid economic growth. Texas and Nashville, for example, have become economic hubs to rival California or Chicago. North Carolina, Georgia, Tennessee, and even Alabama have all flourished. Mississippi was missing out. Until now.

Historically, business in Mississippi was highly regulated. Licenses used to be mandatory in order to practice many of even the most routine professions. The state has now lifted a lot of these restrictions, deregulating the labor market. According to a recent report by the American Legislative Exchange Council, a group representing conservative state legislators, the size of Mississippi’s public payroll has been pared back. In 2013, there were 645 public employees out of every 10,000 people in the population; today, the number is down to 607. Last year, Mississippi also passed the largest tax cut in recent history, reducing the income-tax rate to a flat 4 percent.

How did this come about? Policy makers here have drawn inspiration from the State Policy Network, a constellation of state-level think tanks, borrowing ideas that have worked well elsewhere. We got the idea for labor-market deregulation from Arizona and Missouri. Tennessee inspired us to move toward income-tax elimination. Florida’s successful liberalization stands as an example of how we could reduce more red tape.

What was once just a trickle of inward investment has turned into a steady flow. Growth is up, visibly: The areas of prosperity along the coast and around the state’s thriving university towns are getting larger, even if pockets of deprivation in the Delta remain.

Perhaps many in Britain find it hard to accept that Mississippi has overtaken them economically, because they still think of Mississippi as cotton fields and impoverished backwoods, peopled by folk who subsist on God, guns, and grits. But what if Britons’ reluctance to face changing economic realities comes from an outdated perception of themselves?

Most of my fellow Brits like to think that they live in a prosperous free-market society. They have not fully grasped the way in which their country has been sleepwalking toward regulatory regimentation. Stringent new regulations on landlords have seen thousands of owners pull out of the market, resulting in a dire shortage of rental accommodations. New corporate-diversity requirements have imposed additional costs across the financial-services sector, with little evidence that bank customers are getting a better deal.

Individually, none of these restrictions matters all that much. But together, this relentless micromanagement inhibits innovation and growth. And Brits have become so accustomed to government red tape that they no longer seem to see the crimson blizzard that blankets so many aspects of their economic, and even social, lives.

To be fair to them, for many years it did not seem to matter that taxes rose and the regulatory burden grew heavier. Thanks to the use of monetary stimuli in place of supply-side reform since the late 1990s, the country’s economy seemed to defy gravity, engineering the sort of growth that high taxes and tight regulation might otherwise preclude. Few in the U.K. seemed to notice as ever more aggressive doses of monetary stimuli were required to stave off a downturn. Only now that the option of further stimuli has been exhausted are the cumulative consequences of 30 years of folly becoming apparent.

To recognize that one’s country has been run on a false premise for three decades is difficult. To have to acknowledge that Britain is now poorer than the poorest state in the Union could prompt a moment of self-reckoning that many Brits seem determined to postpone.

Britain’s recurrent fixation with the Mississippi Question tells us as much about the country’s state of mind as it does about GDP. Rather than confront uncomfortable truths, my countrymen dispute the data. Instead of facing up to the consequences of bad public policy in Britain, many blame Brexit, or Ukraine.

Vladimir Putin’s war on Ukraine might have caused higher energy prices, but it alone does little to explain Britain’s poor economic performance. As for Brexit, though commentators who originally opposed it love to blame the country’s woes on it now, they never seem to ask why, if leaving the European Union was the cause of Britain’s lack of growth, the country has still managed to outperform much of Europe.

Since Britain voted to leave the EU in 2016, the U.K. economy has grown by 5.9 percent; German GDP has increased by only 5 percent. Unlike Germany, the U.K. has so far also managed to avoid recession. Far from a reduction in trade, Britain has seen a boom in exports, especially in the service sector, since withdrawing from the EU trade block. Service exports grew by nearly 23 percent in real terms from 2018 to 2022—the strongest growth in this sector among the G7 countries, according to data from the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development, and far more than in neighbors such as Italy, Germany, and France.

In any case, Nelson posed the Mississippi Question nearly two years before Britain voted to leave the EU. The country’s lackluster output, productivity, and growth were apparent well before Brexit. Leaving the EU should have been a perfect opportunity to correct course, but little has been done to address the problem. In fact, after leaving the EU, Britain has been hit by a succession of disastrous policy choices.

Having rushed to impose a lockdown in the early stages of the coronavirus pandemic, British ministers insisted on more and more draconian measures long after it was apparent that such steps were disproportionate, as well as ruinously expensive. Then, in the name of achieving net-zero targets on “decarbonizing” the U.K. economy by 2050, successive governments have made rash commitments to move to renewables. Higher energy costs have helped price British industry out of world markets.

Instead of changing course, ministers have stuck stubbornly to their dogma—even though the latest moves to outlaw the internal combustion engine and new emissions regulations are making car ownership unaffordable for millions.

Mississippi has managed to borrow good ideas that have proved to work elsewhere. Britain, by contrast, has preferred to pioneer its own bad ideas. The former approach helps explain why Mississippi is emerging as part of a wider southern success story. The latter approach accounts for why a once-successful country is really struggling.

name: Colin Allred
subject: Inside Elections just downgraded Ted Cruz's chances
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Friend, a lot of folks told me not to run against Ted Cruz.
They said a Democrat can't win a statewide election in Texas and that I should stick with my "safe" seat in the House after winning with 66% of the vote last year. But I'm not one to play it safe when our rights and values are in danger.
And listen, this team raised more in the first 24 hours of our campaign than Cruz did in the entire first quarter of 2023 – and the experts are taking notice.

| Peter--

As the new Chairman of the Washington State Republican Party, I see that we are at a critical point. We can find ourselves hopeless as our beautiful state is completely overtaken by the radical Left; or we can start to fight back and turn the tide of history. **I chose****to fight. And I'm asking you to join me** today.

There's no sugarcoating it: The other side has entrenched bureaucrats, the mainstream media, billionaire donors and unions all working on their behalf.... but we have YOU! Time after time, history has seen political movements and people **rise up in defiance of****tyranny**. Our time is now!

It starts with the individual and builds into a grassroots army, a body that is well organized, has a clear message and a defining purpose.

There are enough votes in Eastern Washington to overturn the whims of King County. Common-sense candidates can offer conservative ideals and win over all voters. I know. I’ve done it. The mainstream media may scoff about Republicans winning statewide. **I am telling you that we can****do it. We will accomplish all of these things. And we will do them together.** If I did not believe this, I would not have run for WSRP Chairman.
---

By signing it today, with thousands of other Republicans, you send a clear message that we still have Republicans in Washington ready to fight for **our****great state and Constitution**.

When you sign the pledge, also consider becoming a member of our **Grassroots Club** by making a small monthly donation of $5, $10, or even $25 to sustain our operations for the next 15 months. 100 people giving $5 a month is far more powerful than a single donor writing a one-time $5,000 check.

body:
I’m starting to worry about our budget.
# [](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/39?t=1&akid=93%2E1163%2Ef7Jz2x)
Hi, it's Zoë, Lateefah's Campaign Manager.
I'm reaching out because I'm getting ready for a meeting with Lateefah in _just three hours_ -- **and right now, we're short on our August fundraising targets.**
But when I meet with Lateefah I want to give her some good news and "we're way behind" isn't it. I would MUCH rather tell her that we've just seen a huge surge in grassroots support.
[**So I'm asking: Can you rush a contribution right now so I can show Lateefah that this grassroots movement really has what it takes to win?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230823?refcode=em20230823-1&refcode2=93_1163_f7Jz2x&akid=93%2E1163%2Ef7Jz2x)
Lateefah is the progressive champion our movement needs right now, and it's on us -- her team, her biggest supporters -- to do everything we can to make sure she has the opportunity to bring our voices with her to Washington.
**But we can't lose sight of the fact that we're in a highly competitive primary.** You have been showing up in a big way — signing up to volunteer, coming to our events, and showing our team support online. We can't afford to lose that momentum right now.
**So before I walk into this meeting with Lateefah, I'd love to show her a surge of donations on our ActBlue dashboard.** Our finance team has crunched the numbers and there's no way around it: After a slow August, we need to pick up the pace in order to hit the goals laid out in our budget.
[**What do you say? Will you be one of the grassroots supporters we need to step up today? If you can, rush a contribution right away.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230823?refcode=em20230823-1&refcode2=93_1163_f7Jz2x&akid=93%2E1163%2Ef7Jz2x)
**[Donate $10 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230823?amount=10&refcode=em20230823-1&refcode2=93_1163_f7Jz2x&akid=93%2E1163%2Ef7Jz2x)**
We're so grateful for your support -- I'm excited to show Lateefah what we're going to be able to accomplish together!
Thanks for everything,
Zoë Kleinfeld

Team, when I fought overseas, I wasn't just fighting for cisgender or straight Americans. I fought for everyone. **Which is why I'm so disturbed that our school board in Bucks County is trying to erase the history and lived experiences of people of color and LGBTQ+ people just to validate their politics of grievance.** They are making the lives of kids of color, LGBTQ+ kids, and anyone who does not fit into their self-righteous and hateful definition of "normal" a living hell. Everyone should be able to speak their truth, and kids deserve to have their truth reflected on the bookshelves of their school libraries. That's why I'm asking you to support not just my campaign, but also the coalition fighting to elect a compassionate, commonsense school board here in Bucks. **[Please, split a donation between Neighbors United and me – their election is in just 76 days. Here's how appalling the school board's record has gotten. They:
* Wrote and passed policies banning symbols of support for LGBTQ+ students, including Pride flags. Enforcement of this vague policy resulted in the temporary removal of a quote from Holocaust survivor Elie Wiesel.
* Created such a hostile environment for LGBTQ+ students that the ACLU filed a complaint. The Department of Education is now investigating the district.
* Wasted taxpayer dollars by hiring a PR firm for $15,000/month to spin their image.
* Wasted even more taxpayer dollars by hiring a law firm that charges $940/hour to defend the hateful policies they pass.

This board has completely lost sight of their mission: to provide all students with the academic and problem-solving skills essential for personal development and responsible citizenship. NOT to ban books, attack LGBTQ+ students, and waste our tax dollars.
And my opponent, GOP Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick, would make things even worse. He voted for a bill that would allow more Moms for Liberty-types to ban books and censor teachers in our schools.
Students, teachers, parents, and taxpayers all deserve better.
**But a far-right venture capitalist is willing to spend unlimited sums of money to keep the school board exactly as it is. That's why Neighbors United needs our help – just like me, they're relying on grassroots donations to overcome big outside money.**
[**Split a donation between our campaigns. Every dollar helps support candidates who care about safe schools and smart budgets – not endlessly fighting "culture wars."**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68532093/423352895/1438346985?refcode=EM_FL_EHA_20230823_ta_schooltand_cand_mf_14da_xx_l2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMGZiYTJhOC1jYjQxLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xZrdl0T8lgXwyfDkbyq5ipv6RKfgt5wzY8wlYG2Z_nk=)
Thanks for being in this fight,
Ashley 🚁

body:
| | | Friends, _**[We have a chance to send a message this year.](http://sendpatriot.campstrategic.com/go/1/5bcfc7c5c9bba8f816f79d307c796b93/40933/cb3c414889de24ab/4b394ec9318b9f9dc3d6b838967d376c/40933)**_ This year we can tell Joe Biden that we are not going to allow him and the Democratic Party to destroy the lives of our children. We can tell Joe Biden and the Radical Left to get out of our classrooms and to stop villainizing our men and women in law enforcement. **_I am talking about the Governor's race in Kentucky_****.** Attorney General Daniel Cameron, a man of strong principles and values, needs our help to fight against the Radical Left’s dangerous agenda and **FLIP KENTUCKY****RED****! **
---
[](http://sendpatriot.campstrategic.com/go/1/5bcfc7c5c9bba8f816f79d307c796b93/40933/cb3c414889de24ab/3a2b21691e837323c3d6b838967d376c/40933)

| | | The first Republican presidential debate is tonight, and with at least 8 candidates on stage, we can count on a supersize helping of utter BS and conspiracy theory nonsense. [**The moderators need to call out these lies in real time. They can't just ignore lies, and depend on the other candidates to push back, since they'll be lying as well. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Money Can't Buy Everything
If we allow ultra wealthy donors, dark money, and corporate PACs continue to buy elections, the rural worker will be forgotten.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
,
Growing up in a humble, working-class home, my family faced its fair share of challenges. Sometimes, putting food on the table was a struggle, but we always found a way to make it work. With resilience, tenacity, and grit, we persevered.
Contributing to a political campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] would have been unimaginable to my family. We may not have had much, but my family filled our home with joy, laughter, and love. Like countless rural families in Northern Michigan and the UP, we were rich in what truly matters.
Money can't buy happiness, love, trust or votes... But it can fuel our message.
Your contribution to my Congressional campaign, no matter the amount, will help us pay our dedicated workers [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] — a field team of passionate door knockers and phone bankers — and help spread our message of unity and progress.
It's because of my background that I hate asking for money. We desperately need campaign finance reform. Until then, to keep fighting for the rural worker, I have to make the difficult ask.
I'm running for Congress because we need a workhorse. We need someone who truly understands the hopes and dreams of the rural working class.
I've proudly focused my medical career around the patients who need it the most — low-income folks like me from the so-called 'other side of the tracks'. I am committed to the underdogs and running for Congress to be the leader I needed as a child.
I understand that times are tough for many, so any support you can provide is greatly appreciated. Every dollar counts.
Thank you for your consideration,
v/r
-Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan & the UP
Democrat, MI01

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health. In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular. Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, Protecting the unborn, Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, Expanding education freedom, Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, Lowering prescription drug costs, Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, Creating a universal school choice program, Delivering record-breaking tax relief, Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history. This year, Governor DeSantis signed: Record tax relief ESG prohibitions Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation. Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI Improvements to our state's infrastructure Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. name: American Briefing
subject: C.S. Lewis’s Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions

| This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9rsv61v727ggbedhnonmodvk78fprslv1sg3qpo_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3h64or2cth2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zj8r1luqg6k0q9kgvfa3ou90d2amm9sb97e7eov0_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3h64or2cth2bs)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2fr5s5s6vsamg1isug9s3ok63ff356np8btslp0_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3h64or2cth2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ztvk6pi71b6guhqqq4uvdpdmgr1rvbbdies56668_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3h64or2cth2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College
---

With the rise of Cancel Culture and socialism on college campuses, it's become a hostile environment for pro-liberty students and alternative viewpoints.

__Keep reading to learn how you and I can STOP this ugly trend towards censorship and violence_._

But this has never stopped Students For Liberty (SFL) from promoting the ideas of free speech, free market capitalism, and individual freedoms!

My name is Dr. Wolf von Laer, and I am the CEO of Students for Liberty. Students For Liberty (SFL) is a 15-year-old non-profit educating young people about the philosophy of liberty, developing their leadership skills, and empowering them to make the world freer.

_Universities fail to teach basic skills and the ideas of liberty_. We solve both these failures and build an international network of Local Coordinators who are making a difference with elected politicians, authors, journalists, business people, and so much more.

**SFL students and our Local Coordinators are on the FRONTLINES of the battle of free speech on college campuses across the world.**

My goal is to raise $25,000 this week to prepare for the upcoming school year. It costs us roughly $2,500 to train and empower a student pro-liberty volunteer to defend the Constitution and free markets on America's campuses and universities. * Free speech
* Free market capitalism
* Sound Money - It's time to End the Fed!
* Empowering students with leadership skills, communications training, and much more

Students For Liberty's Local Coordinators are pro-liberty activists like you've never heard of or seen before.

You would be amazed at what these young liberty activists can accomplish after you ignite their passion for liberty and give them the tools to succeed.

In fact, roughly 90% of our events, and we had over 2,000 last year alone!!! - conferences, trainings, business and talent incubators, and networking events - are STUDENT-led events.

The skills they acquire through organizing conferences, developing projects, reaching out to more students, and fundraising will make them better leaders in their respective fields tomorrow. Some have gone on to become journalists, businesspeople, politicians, and academics. And the others continue to spread the ideas of liberty within their personal sphere.

[](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
When I launched this campaign in late February, we were polling at 0%. Washington insiders weren't paying attention.

But, Fellow American, now they are.

I want to make a big splash tonight – but we also need to raise as much money as possible between now and the time I take the debate stage in Milwaukee.

Before the day is over, I want to secure an additional 500 donations to Team Vivek to show the DC Establishment the strength of our movement. **[Will you chip in?](http://trk.secureandprosper.)**

**[Whether you can give $1, $10, or $100 today](http://trk.secureandprosper.)** – that doesn't matter to me. It's the fact that you're in this fight with me.

I am not counting on Super PACs to fund this campaign – I am counting on you.

**Fellow American, let's show DC insiders the strength of Team Vivek!**

Thanks,

[](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
Vivek Ramaswamy

| [** WATCH NOW →**](http://trk.secureandprosper.-VQjwdwcWQg)

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Dear Patriot,

After receiving tips from concerned parents in Livingston, NJ, my team investigated and found that "equity, inclusion, and diversity" was taking precedence over reading, writing, and arithmetic with elected school board members.

**Indoctrination starts behind closed doors in almost every instance - whether in school boards nationwide or in corporate America training rooms.**

Radicals attempt to push identity politics on just about everyone - and our kids are the most vulnerable.

The best way to handle this is by exposing it, **and that's why my team at OMG is handing out cameras to parents around the nation** - empowering them to break their own stories and impact their community with change.

So, when I showed up at a school board meeting in Livingston, NJ, to announce our effort to arm parents with undercover cameras, the board's chairman, Vineeta Khanna, **ironically ordered me to stop recording (violating New Jersey's recording laws).**

While I asked my cameraman to put his camera down, I made the announcement and then proceeded to show them how they would be recorded by pointing out a hidden camera in the room - they didn't seem thrilled.

Thankfully, Ms. Khanna and elected school board members around America cannot stop parents equipped with hidden cameras and trained to ethically use them.

**Now here's where things got interesting.**

As I left the meeting, I faced local law enforcement who had been called on me!

[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c30242993188472cb3deae09ffbe783e&_e=9YtnugounwpKoWu0XKOHyixuUB3VityYR43QBDRknjskLFmtgyXx1_UxbBhzVvKr6skByEZ--WPyfVEQBjvhGDVdmTIJSakDZ439laPDdBjdLCRnOOopZVUcmZlMqXoR0zYfvLhZlIg-L8EfcBAdbNeJLJrmJ8ULogASA_PWEPizaRz658qcV_-iyxrQNAUJ4Nmo92bOzDOMbAFYpUf_2ZqErjqkgFDwr99dfg-7AWHbhtN_UTmxhdCFv8vZYMOuBST06nUALmlvZ12lSf5xR7KjL0DBBbOhXtmVJ5jvUC_J5D6v_sYgCaxXrC70fCodmIzJPlqVe499SCVjeKLy8jqOGftRVydkRCgg50e_xNb1tNkULEpVDTdKOTTQB_-ZG6-gfqnGcTzyvaAYrXiG7A%3D%3D)
I can't make this stuff up.

Their fear of exposure, combined with their ignorance of the law, should alarm us all - as these are the folks tasked with leading entire school districts to educate our children while setting an example of morality and character values.

Do you trust them?

**I certainly don 't.**

**[Watch the video here](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c30242993188472cb3deae09ffbe783e&_e=9YtnugounwpKoWu0XKOHyixuUB3VityYR43QBDRknjskLFmtgyXx1_UxbBhzVvKr6skByEZ--WPyfVEQBjvhGDVdmTIJSakDZ439laPDdBjdLCRnOOopZVUcmZlMqXoR0zYfvLhZlIg-L8EfcBAdbNeJLJrmJ8ULogASA_PWEPizaRz658qcV_-iyxrQNAUJ4Nmo92bOzDOMbAFYpUf_2ZqErjqkgFDwr99dfg-7AWHbhtN_UTmxhdCFv8vZYMOuPHFL4hKjBOn1DrMSGMynEBeuUjg8VvN5cuMwOlT3FlSTKV3o2Lm0F8GgZNao_uPpvxZosawLsH2G98qzoLcIQCS-rqmcyzUy7vAj8cIoUltThJm8jpemzjQqOSvrm9pqSPAGq_x3k-l6_DJqshuBLA%3D%3D)** , and if you can, please chip in to cover the costs of equipping parents with cameras and knowledge so they can take control of these rogue leaders.

Respectfully,

James O'Keefe

# **Deliver a Letter to Your Representative**
---
We have written a second template letter that mirrors what the House Freedom Caucus (HFC) is demanding regarding the spending fight that needs to happen, but may not, and this letter also needs to be delivered. The problem we are facing is that the House Republican leadership may simply agree to a Continuing Resolution when funding expires on September 30, which would keep spending at this insanely high, post-Covid level. It would also automatically fund all of the DOJ (including the witch hunts against President Trump and other patriots), and it would not include border security and immigration enforcement. Therefore, we need to pressure our representatives to oppose the Continuing Resolution that leadership is trying to cave on. The HFC’s mantra right now is #NoSecurityNoFunding. We want our First Amendment rights secured, as well as our border and our communities, and the only way to do that is to use a normal appropriations process. **The letter about funding can also be found on the**[**commitment form**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)**, along with the first letter about the impeachment inquiry.**
---
**We are asking you to deliver both letters (or just the one about funding if you have already delivered the impeachment letter) to local congressional offices** **on or before Thursday, September 7th – preferably _on_ 7, if you can.** It would likely have more of an effect if the bulk of the letters are delivered on the same day, rather than trickling in over the next couple of weeks.** ** However, if you cannot deliver it on Sept. 7, please try to deliver it before the 7th to ensure it gets to your representative before they leave for D.C. to begin the session the following week. Aim for the 7th, knowing it is better to deliver it on whichever day works for you than not to deliver it at all. So, if you haven’t delivered the impeachment inquiry letter yet, you can now deliver both letters together. If you have already delivered the impeachment inquiry letter, thank you for being willing to go a second time with the funding letter!

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

subject: I'm determined to bring compassion, common sense, and a commitment to change to City Hall

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/94287/images/Jerri%20Green%20Email%20Banner.png]
August 23, 2023
Dear Friend,
I am running to be the next City Council member from District 2 . I am determined to bring compassion, common sense, and a commitment to change to our City Hall. I am writing today to ask for your help. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4XKxVHkB7UCbne-E5bbl6w2]
When I graduated from the Georgetown University Law Center, I decided to dedicate my career to service and have continued that through today. My job has always been to be a voice for those whose stories were going unheard. But beyond my career, what called me to step up and run for office was my three children . They are my special interests.
We're going through a difficult time in our city. All of us have seen the gun violence on the news, suffered through multiple power outages, and wondered what this community can do to keep our youth engaged long enough to stay in Memphis and make its future better. I believe we can do better. We MUST do better.
My slogan is “ One tough mother, ” and it’s not just a fun play on words - ask anyone, it’s the hardest job out there. And with it comes a special set of skills — like cleaning up a mess that you didn’t make. I am ready to tackle the challenges and the important issues facing our city at this time, and my dedication will be unwavering . I will fight for children, parents, families, and everyone who feels their voice isn’t currently being heard.
CONTRIBUTE TO JERRI GREEN FOR CITY COUNCIL [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4XKxVHkB7UCbne-E5bbl6w2]
I hope if you haven’t already, you will take a minute to visit www.jerrigreen.com [http://www.jerrigreen.com] to learn more about me and why I am running. I also hope you will join me in this campaign for change because it is going to take all of us.
Sincerely,
Jerri Green
#OneToughMother

My job has always been to be a voice for those whose stories were going unheard. But beyond my career, what called me to step up and run for office was my three children . They are my special interests. We're going through a difficult time in our city. All of us have seen the gun violence on the news, suffered through multiple power outages, and wondered what this community can do to keep our youth engaged long enough to stay in Memphis and make its future better. I believe we can do better. We MUST do better. My slogan is “ One tough mother, ” and it’s not just a fun play on words - ask anyone, it’s the hardest job out there. And with it comes a special set of skills — like cleaning up a mess that you didn’t make. I am ready to tackle the challenges and the important issues facing our city at this time, and my dedication will be unwavering . I will fight for children, parents, families, and everyone who feels their voice isn’t currently being heard. name: Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.
subject: Participate in a National Day of Service
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM KENNEDY
body:
“Ask not what your country can do for you. Ask what you can do for your country.” On September 11th this year, I am asking all of us the same question.

| [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_unopens_2&n=1)
---
Peter -- In his Inaugural Address, which I attended when I was 7 years old, President John F. Kennedy encouraged Americans to “ _Ask not what your country can do for you. Ask what you can do for your country.”_ On September 11th this year, I am asking all of us the same question. September 11th is recognized each year as a National Day of Service and Remembrance. This year, I’m asking all of those who support my campaign to honor the memory of those lost on this day by doing their best to participate in a [National Day of Service.](https://www.kennedy24.com/september-11-day-of-service?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_unopens_2&n=2) [](https://www.kennedy24.com/september-11-day-of-service?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_unopens_2&n=3) I believe campaigns shouldn’t just be about collecting donations and doing television advertising. This campaign is a part of a broader purpose to recommit our country to community service. We should all consider what we can do for our country, right now, today. I want to see change happen now – not in some distant future. That’s why I am calling on all those who support my campaign to engage in service projects on or around September 11th this year. I am asking you to consider what your community needs most, and then to design a project that addresses that need. This could be anything from a beach clean up to spending time fixing up a school. You could read to children or distribute food to people in need. Once you decide how you’re going to serve or if you want to organize a project in your area, post about it on the website. | [](https://www.kennedy24.com/september-11-day-of-service?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_unopens_2&n=4 "SUBMIT YOUR SERVICE PROJECT") [SUBMIT YOUR SERVICE PROJECT](https://www.kennedy24.com/september-11-day-of-service?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_unopens_2&n=4)
---
Once you post your service project, others in your area can find it on the website and RSVP to join you in service. But you don’t have to be the one to organize a project. You can simply visit our [Day of Service Events](https://www.kennedy24.com/september-11-events?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_unopens_2&n=5) page to search and find service projects in your area and sign up to attend.
Regardless of your political standing, we can all come together for the common human value of service. A way we can heal the divide in the Nation is to come together as a community to help others in need. Let’s use the strong momentum of this campaign to begin repairing our country, and bring people together for a day of helping your community. I’ll be out there, by your side.
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.
P.S. Team Kennedy has designed [an elegant commemorative t-shirt for this initiative](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=92YYov9O17-vE3x_2FgMqcpC3Uu0TtfyErPHzkeABYjoC-VXKOry0umcl-b5ZjM4E8op1cOp14wjZfxVsUUuwQ&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_unopens_2&n=6), which is available in our merchandise store, which you may choose to wear on your Day of Service and beyond!
[Donate today](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_unopens_2&n=7) to put a Kennedy back in the White House — Elect Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. as President to unite America in 2024! Make sure to join us on Social Media to help spread our campaign's message and put Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. in the White House! [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6nQ2OSzJvbzn8H14UVJyZeU&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_unopens_2&n=8) [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=YqgukYA3Mrlri-dqG7I8TvJMDEmDChn4crVEdym-uYEvPdkFBV9SaYXx39MwIdLI&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_unopens_2&n=9) [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=6hyvAYXBs1PELL28GD73y2F3NBqF5BJJJ4dLoTp9j7umB4CtvDL9QcHxwZkP_0TO&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_unopens_2&n=10)

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=641%2E135344%2EOLLAMI)

Hi there -- it’s Congressman Jamie Raskin, the Representative for Maryland’s 8th Congressional District.
**Today, I am in Ann Arbor to announce my endorsement of my friend and colleague Elissa Slotkin to represent Michigan in the U.S. Senate.**
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230823-1-30&t=2&akid=641%2E135344%2EOLLAMI) **[Donate to Elissa >>](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230823-1-30&t=3&akid=641%2E135344%2EOLLAMI)**
I could run through all the bills Elissa and I have worked on together and issues we’ve stood shoulder to shoulder to fight for -- on choice, on voting rights, on infrastructure, on gun violence and more. But today, I just want to tell you the things that come to mind to me when I think about her.
Elissa’s office is right across the hall from mine, so the first first people I see every day when I go to work are Michiganders lined up outside of her office._And the last people I see when I leave work everyday are Michiganders congregating outside of her office._
That’s because she’s meeting with her constituents straight through the day — veterans, students, farmers, labor representatives, small business people. And sometimes when they’re done meeting with her, they stop by my office to say hi. And they always tell me how much they love their Congresswoman.
She’s just about the most accessible politician you can find, and I know she will continue to be accessible to the people across Michigan.
**Something else about Elissa: She’s tough. She’s someone you want on your side in a battle.** She’s always fighting for the right things. She’s the type of tough and compassionate leader we need in the U.S. Senate, but she’s going to need our help to get there.
**[I told Elissa I would help her raise $10,000 to help her build the strong grassroots foundation she’ll need to win. Will you join me in supporting her by chipping in a few dollars to her campaign now?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230823-1-30&t=4&akid=641%2E135344%2EOLLAMI)**

Friend, I am running for President to lead our nation out of decline. It is time to usher in a reckoning for the elites in Washington, DC and revival across our country, and that is why I am taking the stage on Wednesday at the first GOP presidential primary debate. **I am writing you this message today to make sure you know what I 'm fighting for. ** In Florida, we went out and led when it mattered. We chose facts over fear. We chose education over indoctrination. We chose Law and Order over rioting and disorder to make our state a citadel of freedom. Over the years, I've watched the Left chip away at the freedom of our great nation. I am not happy with the state of this country, and I won't let it stand. We've got a lot of work to do. Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. I will NEVER back down from defending and preserving our American freedom. **_That 's exactly what I'm doing._** I am standing up against the Left's radical indoctrination of your children, Biden's disastrous economic policies that are crippling average Americans, and the invasion of our border that has allowed Mexican drug cartels to murder Americans.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

A whopping $4.5 BILLION budget for Health & Welfare was approved this year, by mostly Republican legislators! It was and is the largest budget in state history!

_How did this happen in Idaho of all places?_

The Idaho Freedom Caucus is taking a stand, but we need you with us.

We can't sit idly by while corruption runs rampant.

Here's what you must do:
1. _**Read the report:**_ Understand the gravity of the situation. Get angry and get involved.

If you're as angry as I am, don't just stew in that anger... _use it._

Use it to fuel change and hold those responsible accountable.

The [Idaho Freedom Caucus](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=3d5d1fe8ea&e=dea908e0fe "Idaho Freedom Caucus") is with you every step of the way, but we can't do it alone.

It's time to rise up and take back our state from the establishment hacks.

It's time for courage, determination, and unrelenting pressure.

I'm counting on you.

Let's get this done.

Brian

**P.S.** This isn't a drill or political game. This is about our homes, our families, our future. Get mad, get active, get involved. Enough is enough!

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
|

**Urgent update, Peter: South Carolina’s Supreme Court just upheld a near-total ban on abortion. ** The ALL MALE court’s ruling banned abortions after six weeks — before many women even realize they are pregnant. This is a bad day for women in South Carolina, but also for women all across the South. Until now, abortions had been legal up until 22 weeks, making South Carolina a safe haven for an increasingly hostile region. As you know, one of Jimmy’s main priorities is fighting against the opioid crisis.

Recently a new drug, xylanize, emerged in our community. The drug is being mixed with fentanyl, making it highly addictive and even more dangerous.

In response, Jimmy authored and introduced the Combating Illicit Xylazine Act, which would ban xylazine for human consumption and provide tools to law enforcement to remove the drug from the streets.

Jimmy’s bill was included in the “Support for Patients and Communities Reauthorization”, which was recently passed by the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

[Peter, if you believe we must take action to combat the opioid crisis, will you sign your name right now? ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68539843/423378808/-645564552?source=EM_NBI_JP_20230823_PT_xylazine_0_3MO_TeamPanetta_NA_NA_xylazine&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNWMyMTUyYi1kYzQxLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9tKVdrmcrDwp2gB-B8XqwrRICVbsF75ljAkPxe65fX4=&emci=c93ae67e-0a36-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=f5c2152b-dc41-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=6108787)

clean_body: | | | | It's no surprise that the MAGA-dominated House is proposing outrageous bills – like appropriations bills that cut funding for programs including education, research, public safety, public health, and other areas. Thankfully, we have a Senate majority that makes bills like these non-starters. For now. That's why I'm already thinking a lot about 2024 — and what we need to do to keep the Senate in Democratic hands. Make no mistake, it is going to be a tough cycle. We need to be ready to jump into these key races: OHIO: Senator Sherrod Brown is a powerhouse champion for working folks, which is why he's won three times in a state trending redder and redder. As the chairman of the Banking Committee, he's taken on Wall Street, big banks, the crypto industry, predatory lenders, and more. WISCONSIN: Senator Tammy Baldwin has been elected twice in the swing state that re-elected hard-right Republican Ron Johnson to the Senate in 2022. As Wisconsin's first woman Senator and the first out LGBTQ+ Senator, Tammy's a fighter who's not afraid to smash glass ceilings. MONTANA: Senator Jon Tester has won three times in a state that's picked a Republican for President seven times in a row. It's going to be tough, but Jon's a tough guy, and we'll have his back. PENNSYLVANIA: Senator Bob Casey is a champion for children's health care who's been elected three times in another one of our most competitive swing states. NEVADA: In 2018, Senator Jacky Rosen was the only Democrat to defeat an incumbent Republican Senator. In her first term, she's been one of those folks working hard, away from the cameras, to protect reproductive rights and deliver smart, bipartisan solutions to improve tourism and commerce, among other issues. If you're keeping score, you'll see I just named five seats that Democrats have to defend in 2024 in red and purple states. body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions

| This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zor1u40p7ion2uivd24r2f6lnc0s2lro2s32h740_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3h61o31clh2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z7v4s4v00ojglu2dcke8gd65irlkn8eqpdgevveo_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3h61o31clh2bs)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z73mneeo90bbkt82kjaa657oe9bss1oav5lcc4dg_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3h61o31clh2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zio0rotvl4shu4gt9r5imckmeulkicqf0ge31858_rp22sh2s8i66p72c3h61o31clh2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College
---

As an aunt, one of my favorite August activities is getting photos of my nieces’ and nephews’ first day of school. They're all so excited for their new classroom, new classmates, new teacher, and new school supplies. Who will they sit next to in class? Are there any new kids? What will the teacher be like? How soon is recess? It's an exciting time. But as their aunt, I also can't help but worry about their safety. Which is why, I was the senate prime sponsor of legislation just recently signed into law making our schools officially Gun Free Zones. It’s why I voted for an assault weapons ban and fought to pass a law that makes all of our schools gun free zones. Because we know gun safety laws _work._ **But there's only so much we can do as a state. Until Congress takes action, it's hard for us to keep weapons of war out of Delaware.** So that's why Aunt SaSa (that’s me!) wants to become Representative Sarah. **Because school should be a place of growth and learning and fun. Not a battlefield. I'll fight for a national assault weapons ban, universal background checks, and removing the ban on federal funds being used to study gun violence.** I'm proud of my record fighting to reduce gun violence and save lives in Delaware. But the NRA doesn't – and I'm expecting they will attack my work. [**So I'm asking, if you can, will you pitch in to my campaign to represent Delaware in the U.S. House? clean_body: | = As an aunt, one of my favorite August activities is getting photos of my nieces’ and nephews’ first day of school. They're all so excited for their new classroom, new classmates, new teacher, and new school supplies. Who will they sit next to in class? Are there any new kids? What will the teacher be like? How soon is recess? It's an exciting time. But as their aunt, I also can't help but worry about their safety. Which is why, I was the senate prime sponsor of legislation just recently signed into law making our schools officially Gun Free Zones. It’s why I voted for an assault weapons ban and fought to pass a law that makes all of our schools gun free zones. Because we know gun safety laws work. But there's only so much we can do as a state. Until Congress takes action, it's hard for us to keep weapons of war out of Delaware. So that's why Aunt SaSa (that’s me!) wants to become Representative Sarah. Because school should be a place of growth and learning and fun. Not a battlefield. I'll fight for a national assault weapons ban, universal background checks, and removing the ban on federal funds being used to study gun violence. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States. I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago – an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something – that we do love this country. I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A. I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I’m running for President because we have a country to save! I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor” because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. And I’ll do it as your next President. It quickly became a standing-room-only event! = I'm grateful to have a strong working relationship with the unions throughout our state and proud to have stood with members of IBEW Local 995, Ironworkers Union Local 623, Amalgamated Transit Union Local 1546, the National Association of Letter Carriers Local 136, and many more. Peter, I know that together, we can elevate the voices of working folks and build a stronger Louisiana that works for everyone. | | Hello everyone, Ahead of this evening’s debate, we wanted to flag some key resources and guidance on all the Biden-Harris administration has done for the communities that make up the Democratic Party. Below you will find toplines on the campaign’s and DNC’s engagement around the debate and where we will be responding online.

Sincerely,
The DNC Coalitions and Community Engagement Team **–** **Team-Biden Harris Holding Republicans Accountable During First Debate**
* Team Biden-Harris will have a [robust rapid response](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=e880aac504&e=d6c5c7d7ec) strategy for the first GOP debate - which will hold Republicans’ accountable and highlight the contrast between their extreme agenda and President Biden and Vice President Harris’ agenda of growing the economy from the bottom up and middle out and protecting American democracy and freedoms.
* This weekend, the campaign announced a historic [$25 million ad](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=442478436a&e=d6c5c7d7ec) buy that will highlight the president’s economic accomplishments and reach voters across the country and in key battleground states – including the largest, earliest investment in Hispanic and African American media for a reelection in history.
* This ad buy is both the largest and earliest media buy for a reelection campaign into constituency media ever, as well as the largest overall buy for a reelection campaign at this point in time ever, ensuring that President Biden’s message is heard throughout this year’s Republican primary.
* Watch “Fought Back” [HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=00e84f46b4&e=d6c5c7d7ec),
* Watch “First Day” [HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=46a163751d&e=d6c5c7d7ec),
* Watch “Nosotros” [HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=1b4e0ea9c3&e=d6c5c7d7ec) and,
* Watch “It’s Us” [HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=7157cb650d&e=d6c5c7d7ec).
* Officials, including Biden-Harris campaign co- chair Cedric Richmond and DNC Chair Jaime Harrison, will be on the ground in Milwaukee this week to meet with local leaders and key constituencies, while an aggressive war room run jointly by the Biden-Harris campaign and the DNC out of Washington will hold Republican candidates accountable for the extreme MAGA views they espouse from the debate stage.

**Biden-Harris 2024 Launches New Wisconsin Ad Ahead of RNC Debate** Today, Biden-Harris 2024 is announcing its first state-specific ad in Wisconsin ahead of the first Republican debate. As Republicans head to the debate stage to spotlight their out of touch and extreme views, President Biden’s reelection campaign is focused on highlighting how his agenda is creating good-paying jobs right in Wisconsin. The ad features Kilah Engelke, a cement mason by trade and a mother of two based in Milwaukee, who speaks firsthand about how President Biden’s economic legislation is making life better and increasing wages for working families like hers. The new ad is slated to begin running on Wednesday ahead of the RNC debate in the Milwaukee market.
