name: Team AOC
subject: Sign today: Climate emergency petition for President Biden
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We are out of time and excuses.
#
Last month, we experienced the hottest 3 days in recorded history.
Days later, 2 days of historic rainfall in Vermont led to catastrophic flooding.
And just 2 weeks ago, Maui was devastated by the deadliest wildfires in the modern history of the U.S.
**Our planet is in crisis, and to address it we have to mobilize our social and economic resources on a massive scale.**
[It’s time for President Biden to declare a climate emergency. Add your name to Sunrise Movement’s petition today to tell the President: we are out of time and excuses.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/20718?utm_source=em20230823-4864&t=1&akid=4864%2E2526796%2Et4cr_a)
**[Add your name to the petition →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/20718?utm_source=em20230823-4864&t=2&akid=4864%2E2526796%2Et4cr_a)**
Alexandria recently reintroduced the Climate Emergency Resolution in the House to demand that President Biden use existing authority and emergency powers to combat the climate crisis. **Now, Sunrise Movement is asking you to join the call.**
While the Inflation Reduction Act made record-breaking climate investments, **declaring a climate emergency under the National Emergencies Act would allow President Biden to take direct action against the climate crisis** , including:
• Reinstating the crude oil export ban
• Ramping up domestic manufacturing of clean energy technologies
• Deploying resilient energy infrastructure and phasing out fossil fuel production on public lands and waters
• Ending our dependence on fossil fuels by massively deploying renewable, resilient energy
[Will you sign your name today and tell President Biden that it’s time to call this moment what it is — a national emergency?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/20718?utm_source=em20230823-4864&t=3&akid=4864%2E2526796%2Et4cr_a)
**[Add your name to the petition →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/20718?utm_source=em20230823-4864&t=4&akid=4864%2E2526796%2Et4cr_a)**
In solidarity,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20230823?refcode=em20230823-4864-P_ORG_ANO_ORG&t=5&refcode2=4864_2526796_t4cr_a&akid=4864%2E2526796%2Et4cr_a)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20230823-4864-P_ORG_ANO_ORG&t=6&akid=4864%2E2526796%2Et4cr_a)**

| | Dear Peter,
---
| As proud members of the Republican Party of Nebraska, we have reason to celebrate the incredible progress we've achieved in the past year in our commitment to ensuring a quality education for every child in our great state.

But we’re only at the beginning of our journey to change the reality that only **43% of our 4th graders are proficient in math. For reading, only 34% are proficient.** We MUST improve these numbers together!
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=0f58c502f1&e=25844e23a8)
---
| The foundation of effective and responsible citizenship begins with a solid education, and we have been hard at work to uphold this core value.

Over the past year, we've championed the belief that educational decisions should be firmly in the hands of parents and guardians. **It's our conviction that every student deserves the opportunity for an exceptional academic journey.**

_**To continue on this path of success, we need your support more than ever**_. The challenges facing our education system require united efforts and resources. By contributing to the Nebraska Republican Party, you'll be investing in the very essence of our future – our children's education.
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=9f9d3a207f&e=25844e23a8)
---
| Your support enables us to promote parental choice through programs like vouchers and tax credits, fostering competition that can elevate the quality of education across all schools, whether public, private, or home-based. We'll also continue to advocate for the rights of parents to observe classroom activities.

**Join us in celebrating the victories we've achieved together in the past year and help us pave the way for an even brighter future for Nebraska's children.** [**Your contribution will ensure that our principles endure and that our children receive the education they deserve!**](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=9dbd144d32&e=25844e23a8)

| Let's stand united in defense of quality education and a prosperous future for our state. Contribute now and make a lasting impact!

Thank you for your unwavering support.
---
| For Our Children,

Todd Watson - Political Director

9/9/23 No Mountain Valley Pipeline (MVP) Southgate: Impacted Communities Conference
---

| Hi, it’s Jane Fonda. If you’re reading this, it’s likely you receive a lot of emails from us. I wanted to take a moment to explain why we send them and why your support matters to the Jane Fonda Climate PAC and the candidates we support.

_**Here are 3 reasons why every investment counts:**_

1️⃣ _**We rely on grassroots supporters like you.**_ We wish we didn’t have to ask people to part with their hard-earned money, but our ability to support candidates depends on a lot of individuals being willing to support however they can.

2️⃣ _**We focus our support where we can have the biggest impact.**_ Our strategy combines direct financial support and smartly leveraging our ability to reach people in down-ballot races where even modest financial support goes a long way. **With your support in 2023, we have already been able to make a major impact on state & local races across the country from Virginia’s state legislature primary wins to key victories for local Climate Champions in Denver, San Antonio, and Pittsburgh.**

3️⃣ _**The climate crisis is here.**_ Day after day, we are seeing the effects of burning fossils on our communities. The fossil fuel industry is dedicated to investing in politicians who will let them continue to get away with it. We can’t take a break from demanding climate action because the climate crisis is getting worse every day. And with your support, I strongly believe the climate movement is in great hands, but there is still so much work to be done.

We don’t say any of this to scare you – anyone who tries to scare you into giving them money should rethink that strategy. If nothing else, our goal is for you to feel hopeful – our team and the rest of the climate movement are working every day out of hope for a livable future, and we hope you consider yourself part of our team.

Every dollar you invest in the Jane Fonda Climate PAC has an immediate impact on the decisions we make, _**and we cannot do it without you.**_ [__**Our next step is to make sure we have the resources to fund our next round of endorsements, so we’re asking today if you can contribute $10 to help us get there.**__](https://click.everyaction.com/k/68554089/423397842/931981458?refcode=BLU-JANE-20230823-z-EM&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZjYzkwMjQ1LWVjNDEtZWUxMS1hM2YxLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=K55d5_Mt-ECMfGQSPoo4ORzmWFzyKLQ54VdH_R1EHbM=)

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Justice Democrats has spent the last six years working to elect young,
diverse, progressive candidates who bring their lived experience — not
loyalty to corporate interests or industry lobbyists — to Congress, and
we’re seeing it make a difference.

Just look at Cori Bush. Justice Democrats rallied behind Cori in 2020 as
she went up against a long-time Democratic incumbent who was out of touch
with the people of Missouri’s 1st district, and won by a slim margin.

As a registered nurse, community activist, organizer, single mom, and
ordained minister, Cori was determined to do right by the people of St.
Louis and fight for everyone’s opportunity to thrive.

Just hours after violent right-wing insurrectionists stormed the U.S.
Capitol on January 6, 2021, Cori began her first term in Congress by
partnering with fellow Justice Democrats freshman member Jamaal Bowman to
introduce a resolution to remove every Republican representative who
supported overturning the 2020 presidential election.

As folks in Missouri and the rest of the nation continued to deal with the
ongoing challenges of the coronavirus pandemic, Cori went on to fiercely
fight for strong COVID relief packages, which led to her unforgettable
protest to extend the federal eviction moratorium.

When Congress adjourned for summer recess and vacations that August,
leaving the eviction moratorium with just hours left before it would
expire, Cori took a stand. As someone who’s been evicted and faced
houselessness first-hand, she couldn’t sit by and watch millions of people
get kicked out and forced into the streets. So, like the activist she is,
she slept overnight on the steps of the U.S. Capitol for days and (as the
New York Times described) “galvanized a full-on progressive revolt.”

Fellow Squad members and progressive activists joined her in solidarity,
and after making national headlines for her multi-day demonstration, Cori
learned the Biden Administration announced a 60-day eviction ban in
communities suffering most from COVID. Because of her action, countless
families across the country would continue to have a roof over their
heads.

Since then, Cori has continued to champion racial, social, health care,
and environmental justice and lead the movement to guarantee housing for
all — she’s even introduced legislation to end houselessness by 2025.
That’s because of people like you,
Peter.

Progressives like Cori are in positions of power because of the
groundswell of grassroots support we helped build during their races. If
we’re going to keep Justice Democrats incumbents like Cori in Congress and
elect MORE bright, young leaders like her to office, we’re depending on
your support.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137209?refcode=em20230823-30508&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=30508%2E1203867%2ElG93af ]As Justice Democrats works to prepare for the fights ahead in 2024,
will you split $3 between JD and Cori Bush to fuel our
work? Any amount makes a real difference to support both JD’s work and
Cori Bush’s transformative campaign.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137209?refcode=em20230823-30508&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=30508%2E1203867%2ElG93af ]Contribute $3

With your support, I can’t wait to see what else Cori and the rest of our
bold, progressive candidates do to challenge the status quo and improve
people’s lives.

Thank you,

Alexandra Rojas, Executive Director
Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1021&akid=30508%2E1203867%2ElG93af ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1022&akid=30508%2E1203867%2ElG93af ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Every year, Matt (AKA Gunny) leads our family in planting and caring for our garden. The kids love it; the bunnies love it; the deer love it; I love it.
This summer, we're growing:
* Jalapeños
* Green beans
* Carrots
* Lettuce
* Cherry tomatoes
* Green onion
* Cucumbers
* Eggplant
* Squash

Back at campaign HQ, we like to talk about how we're going to win this election "one neighbor at a time."
**So, in the interest of really treating you like a neighbor, I've decided to share a summer garden recipe with you all.**
_The Barr Family's Quick Pickles:_
_Ingredients:_
2 quart-sized jars
3 or 4 large cucumbers cut up
4 cups of water
2 cups vinegar
2 tablespoons kosher salt
1 tsp sugar
Fresh dill (about 8 stalks) (remove thick stems)
1 head of garlic (remove skin and smash)
Peppercorns
_Directions:_
1. Make brine: bring the water, vinegar, salt and sugar to a boil.
2. Put cut up cucumbers in the two quart jars with dill (about three to four stalks per jar, or to taste), garlic (divided), peppercorns (about 10 per jar or quart).
3. Fill with brine (water, vinegar, salt, and sugar)
4. Put in the fridge for at least two weeks and then ENJOY!!

I hope you enjoy making it as much as I do – and best of luck with your summer harvest!
Best,
Callie
Candidate for Congress in Michigan's 1st District

So, in the interest of really treating you like a neighbor, I've decided to share a summer garden recipe with you all. The Barr Family's Quick Pickles: Ingredients: 2 quart-sized jars 3 or 4 large cucumbers cut up 4 cups of water 2 cups vinegar 2 tablespoons kosher salt 1 tsp sugar Fresh dill (about 8 stalks) (remove thick stems) 1 head of garlic (remove skin and smash) Peppercorns Directions: 1. Make brine: bring the water, vinegar, salt and sugar to a boil. 2. Put cut up cucumbers in the two quart jars with dill (about three to four stalks per jar, or to taste), garlic (divided), peppercorns (about 10 per jar or quart). 3. Fill with brine (water, vinegar, salt, and sugar) 4. Put in the fridge for at least two weeks and then ENJOY!! I hope you enjoy making it as much as I do – and best of luck with your summer harvest! # [#]
First, Happy Birthday to my sister! No matter what you call her, That Woman from Michigan, The Wicked Whitmer of the West or Big Gretch, my big sister has always been an excellent source of advice, constructive criticism that only a sibling can deliver, support, and laughter. The older I get (which will always be younger than she is) the more I appreciate family, old friends, new friends, and community.

When I started kindergarten it was only a half day. On my first day, Gretchen, in second grade, managed to talk her teacher into letting her walk me home to make sure I got there. Her concern for others and negotiation skills at the age of seven were exceptional, so when people ask me if I am surprised by all she has accomplished and the craziness she has lived through, my answer is not even a little bit.

# [#]In our family we were brought up to believe that if you were in the position to help someone out, it was a duty. That you should never punch down, but be unafraid to punch up. And that humor and laughter is critical in dark and confusing times.

So as we near the end of summer, maybe it’s just a little reminder to celebrate our loved ones, find moments of joy, take care of yourself, eat some vegetables (that’s her line) and then get up and do good work again tomorrow.

Happy Birthday Gretchen!

:)
Liz

## Presidential Debate Watch Party
---

For your information, we will not be having our usual SBCRA meeting for the month of August. Instead of the monthly meeting the board will be hosting a Presidential Debate Party on Aug 23rd. As you know the 2024 election cycle is upon us and it is already debate season. Let's have some fun and make a party for the first 2024 Presidential Primary Debate. This is a party, so let's have lots of fun. Wear your favorite patriotic outfits and bring your fun signs and flags. We will have refreshments and fun party games to make the night even better. We will be hosting the party at 412 Studios in Carson, Right by Ikea and the mall.
Please RSVP to
## nenarenae2@gmail.com

**412 studios**
**20620 Leapwood Ave,**
**Suite G, Carson,Ca**

Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

body:
Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/- ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_ypTVam_

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters.

Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/NvbyBYR3K~

Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters.

Sincerely,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces. Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks. But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers. Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters. Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters. Sincerely, Madeleine Foote Deputy Legislative Director League of Conservation Voters ? ? ? ? ? * Take **Mark Finchem** in Arizona, a literal member of the extremist Oath Keepers militia that was involved in Trump’s insurrection. Finchem himself was at the Capitol on Jan. 6, and could have been in charge of Arizona’s elections had we not stopped him.

* Then there was **Jim Marchant** in Nevada, a MAGA Republican who submitted fake elector documents in 2020 to trick Congress into flipping Nevada’s results.

* And there was **Kristina Karamo** in Michigan, who rose to prominence by falsely claiming she witnessed fraud as a poll watcher. Karamo still believes Trump was the true victor of the state. _She also has yet to concede her own race._

We defeated these anti-democracy candidates thanks to unprecedented support from grassroots donors like you. But the battle for our democracy is far from over.

Fellow American - Vivek asked me to reach out to you.

Today is an important day for him. He’ll participate in his first political debate - against politicians who have been in the game for years.

Vivek will be the only political outsider on the stage. Fellow American, I can’t wait for America to hear what my husband has to say.

**[Will you show Vivek that you’re with him by making a Debate Day donation right now?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=6a680c64df2f4e97a74c437544eda090&_e=TX-8nb3Riiy08aVcsDqf4uQuIFU85qvYUDiLFd-urp4V_vezzHn1SC2HkP2UjgzuBVh5n9ZDPcNIr_QkQlsXihG3tUw4JEfNjG2gpdBdRgicwLo1rYOaQ9YUAWGlVRMBzOvU0j85Ecc9gv_PJdkwt2DzRNI7RDSeT0fskXmwDJvmi8wMTGF918rtwektmjyDMU5VT7hn4Zz5iWK8eGhDGPSDaxBSqS2xv65RAPKX0STaBTK0GBuFhVpEYZGvsvBqwIvhlpAeS1l-q_0N0XksR2dJiOuwVJZ842S_aMcmG7Ph4mzbE2n4H3sPHPwev5yO1SbSKQ-7P8WDO60HkrowyVtTNM_rPVxLSbKtPPadV_wloxOMyZlkkDjldxvIWFAiP-uN0TjHSxpy5J9Ytf6B0Vcu9yM2y47BvoVt_SzWGWmtseIfOEqNGHWH0sSe8hTl)**

Vivek has always been ambitious. When we first got married, he told me he wanted to start a company. _**He did it.**_

When the government was getting in the way of running a successful business, Vivek spoke up against woke corporations and ESGs. He told me he was going to write a book that would become a _New York Times_ bestseller. _**He did it.**_

I shouldn’t have been surprised when he told me he wanted to run for President of the United States.

When Vivek puts his mind to something, he gets it done. I know that will not be any different once he’s elected President of the United States and he leads our country toward a national revival.

But Vivek and our team need your help. **[Before the day is over, will you join our growing movement by chipping in $5 or even $50?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=6a680c64df2f4e97a74c437544eda090&_e=TX-8nb3Riiy08aVcsDqf4uQuIFU85qvYUDiLFd-urp4V_vezzHn1SC2HkP2UjgzuBVh5n9ZDPcNIr_QkQlsXihG3tUw4JEfNjG2gpdBdRgicwLo1rYOaQ9YUAWGlVRMBzOvU0j85Ecc9gv_PJdkwt2DzRNI7RDSeT0fskXmwDJvmi8wMTGF918rtwektmjyDMU5VT7hn4Zz5iWK8eGhDGPSDaxBSqS2xv65RAPKX0STaBTK0GBuFhVpEYZGvsvBqwIvhlpAeS1l-q_0N0XksR2dJiOuwVJZ842S_aMcmG7NPw_ibEcC_nUgJ-AJ0AicKZdZ4ArV-8OiYWf19nj0VtHRtOK90z-KzYDpaaYBkF86K2vEFckUmBeU4KCrzVJuQ1QT5P-xj9poIuYa8dWXHHU45HpNsLL94neMasgFNLIhNhWV8n1QFp6f0wfemLdfe)**

I know it means so much to have you in his corner.

Thank you,

Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Big Oil is exploiting the Arctic for profit and putting polar bears in danger![Act now! >>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1943648?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** Friend, it’s no secret that the Arctic is in serious danger. It’s already warming _TWICE as fast_ as the rest of the world. And its wildlife is suffering the worst impacts of human-driven climate change. There’s no denying how serious this is: **Experts believe the entire Arctic region could be ice-free within the next 31 years!** But Big Polluters are still ravaging the land for profit. Drilling and fracking are increasing the rate of global warming. These activities also pollute the area. And Big Oil’s equipment is running over and burying vulnerable polar bears! [**It’s past time for accountability, Friend: take urgent action today and add your name to tell the U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service to END increased oil and gas activity in the Arctic! >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1943649?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1943650?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Legally, Big Oil is _**required**_ to avoid known polar bear denning sites by at least one mile while drilling in the Arctic. But recent studies have shown that the technology used to detect dens has _**MAJOR ACCURACY ERRORS.**_ That means mama polar bears and cubs beneath the snow’s surface could be _**RUN OVER and KILLED**_ without a second thought.
The damage doesn’t end with polar bears, Friend. With more drilling comes noise pollution and toxic greenhouse gas emissions. These side effects impact the entire landscape. And nearby residents are left to suffer the consequences -- including increased risk of oil spills that could **destroy the fragile ecosystems that local communities rely on for survival.**
But the Biden Administration recently approved a rule permitting _**even more**_ oil and drilling activity in the Arctic. We have to put an end to this pattern NOW -- before any more polar bears die and more communities are put in danger. [**Please, Friend -- Raise your voice now and tell the U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service: no more drilling in the Arctic! >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1943651?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

name: CaucusRoom
subject: America Needs to Wake Up
body:
What you need to know today. No images? [Click here](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-e-ayhiliy-trhiujldw-g/) [](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-ayhiliy-trhiujldw-r/)
## **Happy Wednesday! Here is the[ _lineup_](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-ayhiliy-trhiujldw-y/) for the RNC Debate tonight! One GOP hopeful is [_threatening legal action._](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-ayhiliy-trhiujldw-j/)**

body:
Almost 90 percent of Americans live in counties hit by a climate disaster within the last 10 years, and more than 600 U.S. hospitals are at risk of closure.
#
Peter,
Our health care system is not immune from the climate crisis that is wreaking havoc and destruction across the country. **Almost 90 percent of Americans live in counties hit by a climate disaster within the last 10 years, and more than 600 U.S. hospitals are at risk of closure.**
That’s why Pramila has partnered with Senator Edward Markey to introduce the Granting Resources for Eliminating Emissions Now in (GREEN) Hospitals Act. This legislation would invest $105 billion to revive a New Deal-era program to modernize and weatherize health facilities to reduce emissions and protect public health.
**[Peter, if you agree that we need to fortify our health care facilities against climate change disasters and put public health and safety first, please add your name to urge Congress to pass the GREEN Hospitals Act.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/support-GREEN-hospitals-act/?source=em20230823-2842&t=1&akid=2842%2E420207%2EnL1BtX)**
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/support-GREEN-hospitals-act/?source=em20230823-2842&t=2&akid=2842%2E420207%2EnL1BtX)**
Now more than ever, we need to prepare for the aftermath of climate change and ensure everyone has access to life saving health care. This bill ensures Americans have access to healthcare before, during, and after climate disasters and extreme weather events.
Pramila said it best, **“As hospitals across America provide critical lifesaving care every day, we must ensure they are able to operate under severe weather conditions that have become far too prevalent due to the climate crisis.”**
**Our health care facilities cannot weather our communities through the literal and proverbial storm if they don’t have the infrastructure to protect us now and in the future. That’s why the GREEN Hospitals Act is a critical step towards a health system that recognizes that climate justice is health justice. **
**[Add your name today to urge Congress to pass the GREEN Hospitals Act and ensure that our health care facilities have the support they need to protect our communities.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/support-GREEN-hospitals-act/?source=em20230823-2842&t=3&akid=2842%2E420207%2EnL1BtX)**
Together,
Team Pramila

Cori Bush introduced groundbreaking bills to end solitary confinement and transform our system of public safety. | |
---
Peter, We deserve a world without police violence and without the trauma of mass incarceration. We need to end our country’s instinct to criminalize, and instead build systems of care that value the humanity in every person. This is the vision Rep. Cori Bush is working for. **As the first activist from the movement for Black lives to be elected to Congress, Cori is lifting up the movement’s demands into policy changes.** She just reintroduced the groundbreaking _People's Response Act_ , which supports cities, states, tribal governments, and community-based organizations in launching and scaling public health alternatives to policing -- including investing in unarmed emergency first responders such as licensed social workers, mental health counselors, substance use counselors, and peer support specialists. Cori also recently introduced the _End Solitary Confinement Act_ , historic legislation which would end solitary confinement in federal prison and detention facilities and expand protections for incarcerated people’s right to due process. The bill would also incentivize states and local governments to end solitary confinement in state and local facilities. **On the House Judiciary Committee, she’s led efforts to hold the federal Bureau of Prisons accountable and end mandatory minimum sentencing laws.** She’s championed policies to support families harmed by police violence, and to decriminalize drugs and expunge past drug convictions. And she continues to advocate for incarcerated people’s rights, including restoring voting rights and abolishing the death penalty. [**Cori Bush is leading the push in Congress to reimagine public safety and to end the violence of police and prisons. clean_body: We’d kindly ask visitors not to further degrade the Supreme Court’s credibility when traveling here. | | | | | | Friend, We love when Alaska is in the national news... but not when it’s because a sitting Supreme Court justice accepted a fishing trip to Alaska bankrolled by a partisan, right-wing megadonor. That’s Justice Samuel Alito in the center of the above photograph. The same Justice Alito who wrote last year’s Dobbs ruling overturning Roe v. Wade , and who has been accused of leaking advance information about Supreme Court decisions to high-powered Republican donors. According to recent reporting, in 2008 Alito took a free ride on a private jet owned by GOP donor Paul Singer to an Alaska fishing trip in Bristol Bay — the world’s premier salmon run location. What’s even more disturbing is that Singer later had cases before the Supreme Court, cases that Alito helped decide. | Look, we welcome anyone who wants to relax and enjoy Alaska’s outdoors. We get it — we have a fabulous state. But we’d kindly ask visitors not to break any ethics rules or further degrade the Supreme Court’s credibility when traveling here. It’s not a good look. Friends,
As you probably know, Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis has launched a blatantly political prosecution of President Donald Trump, as well as his allies who questioned the 2020 election in Georgia. They are only doing it for one reason: To stop the voters from being able to elect him president once again. She even asked for his trial to begin the day before Super Tuesday!
The good news is that the **Georgia Freedom Caucus** is fighting back. Our GAFC Vice Chairman, State Sen. Colton Moore, [made national waves](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/03d09d73-e837-4214-87a4-2aa9fe628469?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) last week when he began pushing for a special session of the legislature to review the actions of DA Willis and investigate the weaponization of her office against Joe Biden's top political opponent.
"I'm not going to sit back and watch as radical left prosecutors politically TARGET political opponents," Sen. Moore said. We must strip all funding and, if appropriate, impeach Fani Willis."
Read his full statement here:
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8ab6d28d-ea07-4fa2-9808-a567933ae64e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
President Trump himself also [praised](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4cf4fe61-db5c-4741-bf16-5c1c2ee88efb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Sen. Moore in a post on Truth Social.
GAFC Chairwoman State Rep. Charlice Byrd [announced](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/525acfd7-1734-4a78-9cfb-dbb3533ff14d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) shortly thereafter that she would lead the effort to hold Willis accountable in the Georgia House of Representatives. Weaponized government is one of the biggest threats to American freedom and the political prosecution of President Trump has made a travesty of our justice system.
Please note that none of this would have happened if we didn't have the State Freedom Caucus Network, which helped launch and support the Georgia Freedom Caucus. State Freedom Caucuses are _**absolutely vital**_ in protecting our liberties at the state level, while providing air support for our allies in Washington.
**Texas Leaves the American Library Association**
In our previous newsletters, we have written at length about our war against the American Library Association (ALA) and their self-described "Marxist" president, who want to weaponize our nation's libraries to push a dangerous left-wing agenda on our children. Freedom Caucuses have been fighting in all of their states for state and local library associations to cut ties from the ALA.
Last week, Texas's State Library & Archives Commission announced that they would break ties from the ALA, an effort that was led by State Rep. Brian Harrison, who [announced](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d738014c-6418-4fa4-b766-432adea7e69d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the news on Twitter.
Thanks to our efforts, the movement has gone to states where we have yet to expand our umbrella and the _[Dallas Express](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/10eb81bb-c76d-4d24-b3a8-96e5a3df7509?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ recognized that it was the State Freedom Caucus Network that has led the effort to hold the ALA accountable.
We also hosted a public [Twitter Space](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e32be5ba-c7c9-42c9-8a3a-0a2de734072a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about the ALA last week with Riley Gaines, who shared her experience of a local library trying to stop her from reading wholesome books to children. Riley is an unstoppable force for good and it was wonderful for her to join us on the call.
**The upcoming budget fight in Congress**
When Congress reconvenes in a few weeks, the biggest issue will be over government funding. The House Freedom Caucus has taken a concrete position on the budget: "No Security, No Funding."
HFC will not support any continuing resolution that doesn't include adequate funding to address the crisis at the border, that addresses weaponized government at the FBI and DOJ, and that doesn't end the Left's woke policies in the Pentagon.
The State Freedom Caucus Network will be fully supporting our friends in the HFC as they fight for all of these important issues.
**Keep fighting,**

| | **For Immediate Release** : August 23, 2023
**Contact** : [press@davemin.com](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=110c487991&e=7017cc100e)
**Public Employees Endorse
Dave Min For Congress** _In His Third Major Labor Endorsement Of The Week, CA State Senator Min Earns The Support of The Orange County Employees Association_
**IRVINE, CA** — Today, the Orange County Employees Association announced their endorsement of Dave Min for US Congress in California’s 47th Congressional District. This announcement marks the third major labor endorsement for State Senator Dave Min this week, as he had earlier announced the support of the United Food and Commercial Workers Local 324 and the National Union of Healthcare Workers. OCEA joins statewide labor organizations–the Service Employees International Union and the California Federation of Teachers–as well as an impressive cohort of locals and councils, including Teamsters Joint Council 42, IBEW locals 47 and 441, LAPPL, and IUPAT District Council 36, in endorsing California State Senator Dave Min. Dave Min has a record of advocating on behalf of municipal and county employees, and is emerging as the clear candidate of choice for Orange County’s working families.

“**Dave Min is a champion for Orange County’s working families,** ” said Charles Barfield, General Manager of the Orange County Employees Association. “**He has been a strong and consistent voice for the 18,000 public employees that make up OCEA, and we know we can rely on him in Congress to continue to represent our best interests at the federal level. Senator Min is far and away the most pro-labor candidate in this race. We're proud to join the growing coalition of supporters that are going to help Dave Min win this race for California's 47th Congressional District.** "

The Orange County Employees Association is comprised of thousands of public health nurses, social workers, law enforcement officers, health inspectors and other dedicated workers who keep Orange County running. OCEA is the largest organization of municipal and county employees in Orange County, and–like a growing number of other local, statewide, and national unions–is throwing its early support behind Dave Min as organized labor’s choice in CA-47.

After impressive fundraising hauls in the first and second quarter of this year, Dave Min continues to set the pace for Katie Porter’s open Congressional seat by adding to his political coalition throughout the summer. Min has consolidated support from local, state, and national endorsers. Min entered the race with support from current CA-47 Representative, Katie Porter. In recent months, Min has announced the endorsements of California Lieutenant Governor Eleni Kounalakis, Attorney General Rob Bonta, State Treasurer Fiona Ma, Insurance Commissioner Ricard Lara, Superintendent of Public Schools Tony Thurmond, the Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus’s political leadership ASPIRE PAC, more than 50 local Orange County government officials, and more than 60 state legislators. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=23879daac1&e=7017cc100e).
###
_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=28682%2E3422442%2EbeubtU)
Derek, extreme weather is costing lives, holding back the U.S. economy, and destroying our environment. But in tonight’s Republican debate, I’m doubtful you’ll hear any talk of real solutions.
We can’t afford to wait. **[Can you join me in demanding Republicans and big corporations take climate change seriously?](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-climate-attention/?source=EMAK23_1_PET_20230823_V1_F&akid=28682%2E3422442%2EbeubtU)**
[](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-climate-attention/?source=EMAK23_1_PET_20230823_V1_F&akid=28682%2E3422442%2EbeubtU)
My bill to raise rates on polluters who drill on our public lands finally took effect this year. But there's so much more to do. **Protecting our planet and preparing for natural disasters will be one of my top priorities in the Senate.** I’ll fight to:
* Pass the Green New Deal
* Adequately fund the Environmental Protection Agency
* Create a National Disaster Safety Board to improve preparedness for natural disasters
* Support climate legislation that doesn’t leave any community behind

I never thought I’d have to prepare for a hurricane here in Irvine, but that was the reality for so many Southern Californians last weekend. **[I’ll always stand up to big polluters and the politicians beholden to them and do right by our planet. Can you add your name in support?](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-climate-attention/?source=EMAK23_1_PET_20230823_V1_F&akid=28682%2E3422442%2EbeubtU)**
